text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordanians killed in bus crash in Saudi Arabia. Crown Prince Hassan orders transport of victims in military helicopters to Amman.
- Prime Minister Kabariti meets top Palestinian official Abu Mazen and says "we are satisfied with progress on the Palestinian-Israeli track."
- Parliamentary deputies debating 1997 draft budget say it has not taken into consideration interests of employees and ordinary people "hit by high prices, unemployment and poverty."
- Top Palestinian negotiator tells Kabariti that Israeli- Palestinian talks to be wrapped up within a week and an accord signed over Israeli troop redeployment from Hebron.
- Kabariti, addressing business leaders, emphasises role of the private sector in the formulation of economic policy.
- Kabariti says the government wants to liberalise the economy.
